# Gifts before nursing-home Medicaid: how long is the penalty, and what does it cost?

> Free Medicaid look-back calculator: list gifts and transfers, see which fall in the 60-month window, the penalty period in months and days, the care cost it leaves you to cover, and the date each gift ages out. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
